# SankeyDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSankeyDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasSankey.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasSankey.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasSankey.h"`

## What it is for

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSankeyDiagram> CreateSankeyRenderer( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h );
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSankeyDiagram(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNodeClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeClick` | _Node click_ |
| `onLinkClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, const std::string&)> onLinkClick` | _Link click_ |
| `onNodeHover` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeHover` | _Node hover_ |
| `onLinkHover` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, const std::string&)> onLinkHover` | _Link hover_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
